visual.name: sparklinekpicard
visual.description: KPI card with an embedded sparkline trend: a headline measure with up to two comparison measures, variance indicator, cross-filtering and a granularity-aware date axis.

dataRoles.description: The measure shown as the headline KPI number AND plotted as the sparkline across the Date axis (required). Drives both â€” there is no separate trend field, so the sparkline always follows the selected KPI measure / field parameter.
dataRoles.name: kpiMeasure

dataRoles.description: Categories (usually dates) that drive the sparkline horizontal axis ordering.
dataRoles.name: dateAxis

dataRoles.description: Optional target/goal value used for the Variance and Trend indicators.
dataRoles.name: targetMeasure

dataRoles.description: Optional previous-period value used for the Variance and Trend indicators.
dataRoles.name: previousMeasure

dataRoles.description: Optional DAX measure returning a colour, used as the KPI value's font colour and overriding the KPI Value card's own swatch. Write the condition in DAX, e.g. Color = IF([Sales] > [Sales Target], "#35cf46", "#d64554"). Accepts #RGB / #RRGGBB / #RRGGBBAA, rgb()/rgba(), or a CSS colour name. This replaces the conditional-formatting (fx) button, which Power BI does not support on matrix-based visuals.
dataRoles.name: kpiColor

dataRoles.description: Optional DAX measure returning a colour, used as the Target value's font colour and overriding the Target Value card's own swatch. Same format and purpose as KPI Value Font Color.
dataRoles.name: targetColor

dataRoles.description: Optional DAX measure returning a colour, used as the Previous value's font colour and overriding the Previous Value card's own swatch. Same format and purpose as KPI Value Font Color.
dataRoles.name: previousColor
